description: How much of the book sits behind a country (ISO-2) or a TRBC sector, with the positions behind it. Omit `value` for the ranked breakdown. Always read coverage.classified_pct — sector resolves for only part of the book.

description.name: list_households
description.description: The households this user belongs to, with their ids. Needed only when they belong to more than one — otherwise omit household_id and it resolves to theirs.

description.name: get_portfolio_positions
description.description: Positions for a household, paginated, sorted by market value.

description.name: list_accounts
description.description: Accounts and custody for the household.

description.name: get_risk
description.description: Risk for the household, or for one portfolio. Omit portfolio_id for the household-wide dashboard — volatility, VaR, concentration, drawdown.

description.name: get_portfolio_drift
description.description: Drift of a portfolio versus its target allocation.

description.name: list_facilities
description.description: Credit facilities — balances, limits, rates, maturities, covenants, collateral.

description.name: get_facility
description.description: One credit facility in full, including covenant headroom and pledged collateral.

description.name: list_real_assets
description.description: Real assets — property, vessels, aircraft, art and collections.

description.name: get_real_asset
description.description: One real asset in detail.

description.name: get_real_asset_economics
description.description: Real-asset economics — income, costs, net cashflow and net yield.

description.name: get_brief
description.description: Today's read on markets. kind='market' is the signal-derived pulse; kind='editorial' is the brief the desk authored — regime, themes, risks.

description.name: get_market_data
description.description: Market data for the user's watchlist, with signals where available.

description.name: list_published_content
description.description: Published video, audio and research notes — the desk's catalogue.

description.name: lookup_index_by_brand
description.description: Find alt-asset indices by brand or keyword (wine, watches, art, cars).

description.name: get_recent_results
description.description: Recent auction-realised and list-price events over a look-back window.

description.name: get_signals_recent
description.description: Recent alt-asset trade signals over a look-back window (days_back).

description.name: get_correlations
description.description: Cross-asset correlations by effect type.

description.name: get_equity_fundamentals
description.description: Equity fundamentals — financials, growth, margins, valuation (P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, ROIC), peers.

description.name: run_technical_analysis
description.description: Technical analysis for any instrument — signal consensus, regime, or a full backtest.

description.name: list_layers
description.description: Catalogue of geopolitical map layers you can request.

description.name: get_geo_map
description.description: Global geopolitical intelligence layers over a look-back window.

description.name: get_country_brief
description.description: Per-country geopolitical drilldown (ISO-2).

description.name: list_watchlist
description.description: The household's tracked instruments with price, momentum, signal and volatility.

description.name: list_goals
description.description: Financial goals — target vs current funding, progress, gap and status.

description.name: get_today_brief
description.description: The household's daily briefing — what matters today.

description.name: get_unread_alerts
description.description: Unread alerts for the household.

description.name: get_open_breaches
description.description: Open compliance/policy breaches.

description.name: get_drift_snapshot
description.description: Drift snapshot across the household's portfolios.

description.name: get_upcoming_calendar
description.description: Upcoming dividends, earnings and macro events that touch the book.

description.name: list_family
description.description: Household entities — people and structures.

description.name: get_entity
description.description: One household entity in detail.

description.name: list_documents
description.description: Document metadata in the household vault.

description.name: get_document
description.description: Metadata for one document.

description.name: list_capabilities
description.description: What this Antevo Wealth connector exposes — the whole wealth surface (portfolio, risk, credit, real assets, markets, equity & technical analysis, geopolitics, watchlist, goals, today, family, documents) behind a single connection.
